items.text:
The mix is appealling, sci fi, explore, rogue like, vessel construction, sim like.. etc... and that's the kind of original game that's sort of supply out there. But it's still not easy to play, and kind of frustrating sometime. 
Althrough I would recomand this game warmly :>
items.text_zh:
这种混合很吸引人，科幻、探索、Roguelike、飞船建造、模拟类……等等……而这正是那种市面上有点稀缺的原创游戏。但它仍然不容易上手，有时还挺令人沮丧。
不过我还是会热情推荐这款游戏：>
